reviews.text: Excellent, the best place for bathing and grooming I've found so far! My Maltese loves her groomer, Fernanda. The manager, Anderson, is super attentive, and in short, all the employees, including the valet, are excellent. I recommend it to everyone.

I have a 10-year-old chihuahua and I only take him to Caotry today. It's a trustworthy place, they're super attentive, excellent professionals, and you can take pictures of your puppy on their swing – it's the cutest thing ever!! Plus, they have a coffee area that's delightful!! ❤️❤️

Cãotry is a unique place. Qualified, attentive professionals who are extremely committed to the health of pets. My dog ​​loves the daycare and it's a very trustworthy and credible place. Knowing that he's doing well gives me peace of mind to carry out my daily activities! Congratulations to this wonderful team!

Luke has been at Cãotryclub since he was a tiny puppy, just a few months old. Today he's 5 years old, and I can say I have complete confidence in the team's work.

He's always been very well cared for, and one thing I admire is their attention to detail. Any change in his behavior or health is observed and communicated quickly.

Besides school, he also gets a bath there every Friday, which makes his routine much easier. And when we need it, the hotel is excellent. Having all this in one place makes all the difference.

The most important thing is seeing how much he enjoys being there. When the car approaches the school, he starts barking, eager to get out. I think that says a lot about the affection and care he receives.

Thank you to the whole team for the affection you've shown Luke over these years! 🐾💙

The best place ever. My four-legged son has been going there since he was a baby. And that's been 6 years already. I absolutely love the hotel staff, the management, Ana Claudia, Sharkinho only gets bathed by Thaís, in short… perfect.

I only have praise for The Cãotry Club, for the service, attention, and affection we received from all the staff, from Anderson with his kindness, reception, and friendliness... and the groomers Thais, Mayara, Fernanda, and especially Wesley, who takes care of, grooms, does everything, and gives affection to my pet son Ozzy. You can take them there, I love them ❤️

I have a Spitz and I always use their boarding service, in addition to their bathing and grooming. My little dog is always very well cared for and is happy to arrive at the place! Attentive and dedicated staff!

Very good, I recommend it!
Harley has been staying at this hotel for years. He spent last week there, and as always, everything was perfect.
They send photos every day, you can see that they are doing well and very active (this photo was taken during the week of the World Cup).

I always take Mavie for a bath, and the experience is always excellent. She comes back visibly happy, calm, smelling wonderful, and even all dressed up, which shows the care and affection in every detail.

The professional, Mayara, is simply marvelous: extremely careful, attentive, and very affectionate with pets. You can see her love for what she does and her respect for each client, both human and four-legged. In fact, the beautiful Christmas gift we received was made by her, a gesture full of affection that charmed me.

Mavie loves the place and feels very comfortable there, which is essential for me. The service is always polite, the environment is clean, organized, and inspires a lot of confidence.

Whenever someone asks me for a recommendation, I recommend Mayara without hesitation. I recommend her wholeheartedly!
